text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.title: Join Lerp Options
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.initia: The FOV offset applied at the start of the animation.
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.overal: Total duration for both FOV zoom and screen fade.
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.fadeFr: Enables or disables the black screen overlay transition.
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.easing: Controls animation order (1 = Linear, 5 = Quintic, ... upto 10).
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.worldL: Use this to alleviate not being able to see the animation if the game lags.
text.autoconfig.dynamicfov.option.bezier: Format: x1, y1, x2, y2. !!Bad formatting may crash the game!!
